title: Monotonicity lower bound for the mass of a minimizing 2-cycle in balls centred on its support
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) (C : GeometricCurrentOn univ 2, ℝ^P = Euclid P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ) with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C). Then for every y ∈ spt C and every ρ > 0, ω_2·ρ² ≤ M_{B_ρ(y)}(C), i.e. unitBallVolume 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ 2) ≤ C.massOn (ball y ρ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → ∀ y ∈ C.support, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → unitBallVolume 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ 2) ≤ C.massOn (ball y ρ)
